GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG676.3 (21 Nov 45) CCS
(SCAPIN-330)
21 November 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Japanese Air Navigational Aids (Radio)
1. Additional air Navigational Aids are required by the Allied Occupation Forces for which Japanese facilities of this type are available.
2. It is directed that the quadrant and flight channel indicating radio navigational aids located at Nagoya, Amakusa and Fukuoka be placed in operation as soon as possible.
3. That portion of paragraph 2, directive to Imperial Japanese Government, subject, Communications Control, dated 21 October, 1945, which pertains to operation of flight channel indicator facilities at Sapporo and Osaka re is hereby revoked.
4. It is directed that the Osaka station be operated as a non-directional radio beacon.
5. The Japanese Government shall provide all stations with civilian technical administrative personnel sufficient to operate on a 24 hours per day bases.
6. Orientation of the flight channels quadrants will be furnished the Board of Communications by the Chief Civil Communications Section of this headquarters as soon as determinations have been made.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A. G. D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
